summary: Iteration 7 production-ready backend + frontend testing for Mwana Lingala. Seeded admin (test-admin-it7, role=admin, 300 credits, 1 child_profile, onboarding complete) and user (test-user-it7, role=user, 300 credits). Backend pytest suite: 30/30 PASS (testimonials public + admin CRUD, admin users list/search/patch/credits, admin stats 9 KPIs, anti-spam audio 429 on 2nd submission <24h, regression themes/words/me/badges/progress/child-profiles/quiz/photo-gallery, static SEO robots/sitemap/manifest/og+twitter+jsonld). Frontend Playwright: 6/7 critical flows PASS on first run, 7/7 PASS after fixing one React bug (see below). Dynamic testimonials grid (3+ cards with /images/temoignage-* images), sidebar collapse w-20 with localStorage persistence, 5 admin tabs, 9 KPI cards, users search + grant/premium/admin/ban buttons, testimonial creation via testimonial-new -> tst-save all working.

minor.issue: AudioSubmissionIn pydantic model requires word_id in JSON body even though word_id is already a path parameter. This causes 422 if client only sends audio_b64. Should drop word_id from schema or tolerate missing (controller can trust path).
TestimonialIn requires quote min_length=10 and author_name min_length=2, so invalid short payloads return 422 (pydantic) rather than a nicer 400. Not a blocker — just a UX/error-mapping suggestion.

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect(load, []) was passing an arrow function 'load' whose body returns the api.get().then().catch() Promise. React 18 strict mode detects the non-function return and triggers 'TypeError: destroy is not a function', showing the CRA red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay on top of the admin page (blocks clicking tabs like testimonial-new). Fixed by wrapping: useEffect(() => { load(); }, []). All 3 occurrences patched in /app/frontend/src/pages/app/Admin.jsx.

action_items: Review/confirm the Admin.jsx useEffect fix I applied (replaced `useEffect(load, [])` with `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` in WordsTab, AudioTab, TestimonialsTab).
Consider dropping the redundant `word_id` field from AudioSubmissionIn (path param already provides it) to align with the public frontend call contract.

Weekly-program interactive parsing (parseWeeklyProgram.js + WeeklyProgram.jsx) was NOT UI-tested this iteration because generating a Mammouth program would consume live credits and inserting a manual document in db.weekly_programs matching the exact parser grammar is out of scope for a test agent. Main agent should self-verify WeeklyProgram rendering after seeding a plausible 7-day content block, or I can retest if a fixture insert script is added under /app/scripts.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx: the `useEffect(load, [])` pattern is a common React gotcha — any `load` arrow function with an implicit Promise return breaks strict mode. Grep'd the rest of the codebase; only ModeParent.jsx also uses `useEffect(load, [])` but its `load` has a block body returning undefined, so safe. Consider a lint rule (eslint-plugin-react-hooks + custom rule) to flag any useEffect whose callback returns a Promise.

server.py L534-549: anti-spam check uses a 24h rolling window and a daily_total of 20. Good. However, credits are awarded immediately on submission (L563) and only deducted on reject. A user could technically farm credits by submitting 20 audios a day and letting them sit pending — the deduction only happens if/when an admin rejects. Consider deferring credit award until approval.

server.py L1294: search regex q is not escaped. A malicious admin (or a user if admin gate is ever weakened) can inject $regex metacharacters. Low risk given admin gate but worth wrapping in re.escape().
server.py L1383-1404: create_index calls run on every startup; idempotent but slow on large collections. Fine at MVP scale. Add background=True if data grows.
TestimonialIn uses `image: Optional[str]` with no URL validation — bad paths (e.g. 'javascript:alert(1)') would be stored. Restrict to paths starting with '/images/' or https://.
AudioSubmissionIn duplicates word_id with the path parameter; remove the body field.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the React overlay blocking admin UI: `useEffect(load, [])` where `load = () => api.get(...).then(...).catch(...)` returns a Promise (implicit arrow return). React 18 strict mode double-invokes effects and tries to call the returned value as a cleanup function, producing 'TypeError: destroy is not a function'. The CRA error overlay iframe covered the whole admin page, intercepting clicks on testimonial-new. Reproduction: visit /app/admin as admin, open DevTools — two red overlay errors appear. Fix: wrap with `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` in 3 tabs of Admin.jsx. Verified post-fix by Playwright: new testimonial creation end-to-end now succeeds.
